headline: Kraft Heinz (KHC) Is Down 6.8% After Massive Impairment-Fueled Loss Amid Ongoing Turnaround Investments
summary: Kraft Heinz recently reported second-quarter 2026 results showing sales of US$6,262 million and a net loss of US$5,460 million, largely driven by very large goodwill and intangible asset impairment charges, while also affirming a regular US$0.40 quarterly dividend and completing a US$1.51 billion share repurchase program. The combination of stronger-than-expected underlying earnings, heavier brand and innovation investment, and sizeable noncash impairments highlights the tension between...
